title: Rich window machine
statement: Let $Q$ and $T$ be types with decidable equality, let $k$ be a natural number, choose a radius tape and a destination tape among the $k$ work tapes, and choose an injective assignment of three tape indices to those work tapes. The rich window machine over symbols recording binary digits, simulated Boolean cells, states from $Q$, and tags from $T$ is formed by composing a copy of the radius tape into the first assigned tape, an embedded cell window computation, a move-and-clear operation from the second assigned tape to the destination, and a final clearing of the radius tape. Its states are the rich window state space.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes

A destination tape index among the $k$ tapes
An injective assignment from three tape indices to the $k$ work tapes
caveat: The exact behavior of the auxiliary window, embedding, copy, move-and-clear, and clear machines is not specified by the supplied definitions.
